name: Mathematics (PMn)

rules.name: Two sequences: Sequence 1, Sequence 2, or an approved substitute

children.name: Third coherent sequence approved by the Director of Graduate Studies

rules.notes:
The 100-level courses may have been completed during undergraduate study, and their equivalents from other universities are acceptable.
A third coherent sequence designed by the student, subject to the approval of the Director of Graduate Studies, may be considered a substitute for Sequence 1 or 2.

rules.name: Additional Courses

children.name: 21 units of Math graduate courses numbered 200-297
Courses approved in advance by the Director of Graduate Studies

rules.notes:
Complete 21 units of Math graduate courses numbered between 200 and 297
The courses must be taken at Stanford for a letter grade and be approved in advance by the Director of Graduate Studies.

transferPolicy: Per policy (GAP 4.5.1 Doctoral Degrees, Requirements), all of the coursework for a Ph.D. minor must be completed at Stanford.
reviewNotes: The audit checks two sequences, Sequence 1 and Sequence 2, or one of them plus a third sequence the Director of Graduate Studies approves, and 21 units of letter-graded Math graduate courses numbered 200-297. The 100-level sequence courses may come from your undergraduate study or another university. Checked by hand: the Director of Graduate Studies approves the 200-level courses in advance.
